literal_meaning: ঘোড়ায় জিন বেঁধে আসা (coming after saddling a horse)
figurative_meaning_en: Extremely restless or impatient, unable to stay even for a moment
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এসেই চলে গেল, ঘোড়ায় জিন দিয়ে আসা যেন।
পার্টিতে এসে বসতে পারল না, ঘোড়ায় জিন দিয়ে আসা মতো ছটফট করছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He left as soon as he arrived, as if he had come saddled on a horse.
She couldn't sit still at the party, fidgeting like she had come ready to ride off.
note: Reflects traditional rural imagery of horse riding in Bengali culture
